note: Prompts and the engine whose output was used (1 Oct 2026). Run on Oracle: see gen-art.cjs header.
style: Photoreal, naturalistic, high-key soft daylight, muted sage greens, pale sky blues and warm sand tones, airy haze, premium editorial nature photography with a quiet high-tech feeling, ultra-detailed. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no people.

jobs.name: l-cover
jobs.prompt: A fragment of lush green land floating in a pale misty sky: soft grass, a few wind-shaped trees, a clear stream winding through a small valley toward the viewer, the underside showing layered rock and hanging roots. The island fills the lower half of the frame, centred; the upper half is soft, empty, pale blue-grey sky. A subtle fine halftone dot texture dissolves part of the rock face, as if the land is partly digital.

jobs.name: l-water
jobs.prompt: Calm water surface seen from slightly above, gentle soft ripples, pale silver and light grey-blue tones, high key, minimal, abstract and serene texture, very low contrast.

jobs.name: l-river
jobs.prompt: Aerial view of a braided glacial river flowing through a pale valley toward the sea, silver channels splitting and rejoining across light sand and sage-green banks, minimal, high key; the channels run across the lower half of the frame and the upper half is soft pale haze.

jobs.name: l-ops
jobs.prompt: Macro photograph of a forest-floor cross-section: fine white mycelium threads connecting tree roots through rich dark soil and green moss on top, a natural communication network, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.

jobs.name: l-product
jobs.prompt: A minimalist glass pavilion with slim frames standing alone in a misty green meadow in the morning, soft light passing through the glass, clean architectural lines, calm and precise.

jobs.name: l-creative
jobs.prompt: The volcanic island of Hiva Oa in the Marquesas at golden hour: dramatic green cliffs and ridges, mist drifting over a quiet bay, the Pacific glowing, cinematic painterly light.

jobs.name: l-terraces
jobs.prompt: Aerial view of emerald rice terraces at dawn, orderly curved lines following the hillside, low mist resting in the valleys, soft light, a sense of a calm system running in harmony.

jobs.name: l-failure
jobs.prompt: A smooth dark river stone repaired with fine gold kintsugi seams, resting in shallow crystal-clear water on pale pebbles, soft natural daylight from above, gentle ripples, calm, light and airy.

jobs.name: l-hills
jobs.prompt: Soft green rolling hills with layers of morning mist receding into the distance, one quiet path crossing the nearest hill, wide panoramic view; the lower third holds the hills and the upper two thirds is soft, empty, pale sky.

jobs.name: l-close
jobs.prompt: Flat stepping stones leading across a calm mirror-like lake toward a misty green island at dawn. The stones start at the bottom centre of the frame and curve toward the island on the right. The upper half of the frame is soft, empty, pale sky.
